title: Lagrange's Subgroup Index Multiplicativity
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_1_lagrange_index_multiplicativity
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G] (H : Subgroup G) :
    Nat.card H * H.index = Nat.card G := by
  exact Subgroup.card_mul_index H
physics_justification: Left/right coset partitioning divides the finite group manifold into disjoint orbits of equal measure |H|. Enforcing [Finite G] prevents Nat.card from vacuously vanishing on infinite sets, establishing exact conservation of discrete states across quotient projections.

title: Parallelogram Identity in Real Hilbert Spaces
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_2_parallelogram_law
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (x y : E) :
    ‖x + y‖ ^ 2 + ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 = 2 * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
  exact parallelogram_law_with_norm ℝ x y
physics_justification: The geometric bedrock of quantum state spaces. By the Jordan-von Neumann theorem, the parallelogram identity is the necessary and sufficient condition for a normed space to be induced by an inner product, guaranteeing Euclidean geometry in state space.

title: Banach Contraction Mapping & Unique Fixed Point
math_equation: d(T(x), T(y)) \le c\, d(x, y) \quad (c < 1) \implies \exists!\, x^* \in X: T(x^*) = x^*
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_3_banach_contraction_unique_fixed_point
    {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    {c : ℝ≥0} (hc : c < 1) {T : X → X} (hT : LipschitzWith c T) :
    ∃! x : X, T x = x := by
  have hcon : ContractingWith c T := ⟨hc, hT⟩
  use hcon.fixedPoint
  dsimp
  refine ⟨hcon.fixedPoint_isFixedPt, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  exact hcon.fixedPoint_unique hy
physics_justification: Guarantees deterministic global convergence of iterative dynamical flows, Picard-Lindelöf trajectory integration, and autopoietic self-improving operator equilibrium in ANSE without divergence or chaotic runaway.

title: Cauchy-Riemann Equations Implies Harmonicity
math_equation: \Delta u = \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = \frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right) + \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(-\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right) = 0
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_4_cauchy_riemann_algebraic_core
    (u_xx u_yy v_xy v_yx : ℝ)
    (hCR1 : u_xx = v_yx) (hCR2 : u_yy = -v_xy) (hClairaut : v_yx = v_xy) :

title: Discrete Grönwall Lemma & Dynamic Dissipation Bound
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_7_discrete_gronwall
    (E : ℕ → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (_hE : ∀ n, 0 ≤ E n)
    (h_step : ∀ n, E (n + 1) ≤ (1 + α) * E n) :
    ∀ n, E n ≤ (1 + α) ^ n * E 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    calc
      E (k + 1) ≤ (1 + α) * E k := h_step k
      _ ≤ (1 + α) * ((1 + α) ^ k * E 0) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by linarith)
      _ = (1 + α) ^ (k + 1) * E 0 := by rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc]
physics_justification: Fundamental energy stability theorem in numerical physics. Establishes uniform bounds preventing exponential blowup in discrete time integration schemes for hyperbolic and parabolic PDEs.

title: Fermat's Little Theorem in Modular Arithmetic ℤ/pℤ
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_8_fermats_little_theorem
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    a ^ (p - 1) = 1 := by
  exact ZMod.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one ha
physics_justification: Algebraic basis of modular symmetry groups and discrete topological phases. Verifies that the unit group of the Galois field GF(p) is cyclic of order p - 1, crucial for cryptographic attestation hashing.

title: Markov-Chebyshev Level Set Functional Inequality
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_9_markov_chebyshev_pointwise
    (x ε : ℝ) (_hε : 0 < ε) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (if x ≥ ε then ε else 0) ≤ x := by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact h
  · exact hx
physics_justification: The foundational pointwise inequality of measure theory that integrates directly to P(X ≥ ε) ≤ E[X]/ε. Governs concentration of measure in quantum statistical ensembles and tail bounds in energy minimization.

title: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality in Real Inner Product Space
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_10_cauchy_schwarz_real
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (x y : E) :
    @inner ℝ E _ x y ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ := by
  exact real_inner_le_norm x y
physics_justification: Guarantees that geometric projection and cosine of angles are well-defined in infinite-dimensional real vector spaces. Enforces submultiplicativity of quantum transition amplitudes and bounds kinetic cross-terms.

title: Intermediate Value Theorem (IVT)
math_equation: f \in C([a, b]) \wedge y \in [f(a), f(b)] \implies \exists x \in [a, b]: f(x) = y
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_11_ivt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b y : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) 
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hy : f a ≤ y ∧ y ≤ f b) : 
    ∃ x ∈ Icc a b, f x = y := by
  have h_sub := intermediate_value_Icc hab hf
  have hy_icc : y ∈ Icc (f a) (f b) := hy
  rcases h_sub hy_icc with ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩
physics_justification: Ensures topological connectedness of phase trajectories. Guarantees that continuous physical fields transitioning across energy barriers necessarily cross every intermediate potential level.

title: Cayley-Hamilton Matrix Annihilation Theorem
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_12_cayley_hamilton {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {R : Type*} [CommRing R] 
    (M : Matrix n n R) : aeval M M.charpoly = 0 :=
  Matrix.aeval_self_charpoly M
physics_justification: Governs finite-dimensional matrix dynamics. Allows the exact truncation of linear dynamical evolutions exp(M t) into a polynomial of degree n-1, vital for closed-form propagator computations.

title: Zorn's Lemma (Maximal Element in Inductive Posets)
math_equation: \left(\forall c \subseteq \alpha \text{ chain}, \, \exists u \in \alpha: \forall x \in c, x \le u\right) \implies \exists m \in \alpha \text{ maximal}
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_13_zorns_lemma {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] 
    (h : ∀ (c : Set α), IsChain (· ≤ ·) c → BddAbove c) : 
    ∃ m : α, IsMax m :=
  zorn_le h
physics_justification: Equivalent to the Axiom of Choice. Ensures the existence of maximal orthonormal bases in non-separable Hilbert spaces, ultrafilter compactifications, and maximal ideals in quantum C*-algebras.

title: Baire Category Theorem
math_equation: \overline{\bigcap_{n \in \mathbb{N}} U_n} = X \quad \text{for } U_n \subseteq X \text{ open and dense}
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_14_baire_category {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [BaireSpace X] 
    (s : ℕ → Set X) (ho : ∀ n, IsOpen (s n)) (hd : ∀ n, Dense (s n)) : 
    Dense (⋂ n, s n) :=
  BaireSpace.baire_property s ho hd
physics_justification: Underpins functional analysis (Uniform Boundedness Principle, Open Mapping Theorem). Guarantees that complete energy landscapes cannot be dissolved into a countable union of nowhere-dense fluctuations.

title: Cantor's Diagonalization Theorem
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_15_cantors_theorem {α : Type*} (f : α → Set α) : ¬ Function.Surjective f := by
  intro h
  let s : Set α := {x | x ∉ f x}
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h s
  by_cases hxs : x ∈ s
  · have hx_not : x ∉ f x := hxs; rw [hx] at hx_not; exact hx_not hxs
  · have hx_in : x ∈ f x := by { by_contra hc; exact hxs hc }; rw [hx] at hx_in; exact hxs hx_in
physics_justification: Demonstrates the strict cardinality hierarchy of configuration spaces. Proves that continuum field theories (infinite degrees of freedom) cannot be faithfully represented by discrete countable states.

title: Infinitude of Primes (Euclid's Theorem)
lean4_formal_statement:

physics_justification: The spectrum of multiplicative primes is infinite and unbounded. Essential for cyclic group representations, discrete Fourier transforms across arbitrary frequencies, and p-adic quantum mechanics.

title: Arithmetic Mean - Geometric Mean (AM-GM) Inequality
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_17_am_gm_2 (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) : 
    Real.sqrt (x * y) ≤ (x + y) / 2 := by
  have h : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt x - Real.sqrt y) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt x - Real.sqrt y)
  have h_exp : (Real.sqrt x - Real.sqrt y) ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt x)^2 - 2 * (Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt y) + (Real.sqrt y)^2 := by ring
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hx, Real.sq_sqrt hy] at h_exp
  have h_mul : Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt y = Real.sqrt (x * y) := by rw [Real.sqrt_mul hx]
  rw [h_mul] at h_exp
  linarith
physics_justification: Direct consequence of the convexity of the exponential and logarithmic functions. Bounds thermodynamic entropy maximization and optimal power allocation in physical networks.

title: Irrationality of the Golden Square Root Sqrt(2)

title: Triangle Inequality in General Metric Spaces
math_equation: d(x, z) \le d(x, y) + d(y, z) \quad \forall x, y, z \in X

title: Picard-Lindelöf (Cauchy-Lipschitz) Existence Theorem
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_21_picard_lindelof {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : ℝ → E → E} {tmin tmax : ℝ} {t₀ : Set.Icc tmin tmax} {x₀ : E} {a L K : ℝ≥0}
    (hf : IsPicardLindelof f t₀ x₀ a 0 L K) :
    ∃ α : ℝ → E, α t₀ = x₀ ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc tmin tmax, HasDerivWithinAt α (f t (α t)) (Icc tmin tmax) t :=
  IsPicardLindelof.exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt₀ hf
physics_justification: Rigorous foundation of deterministic classical dynamics in Banach spaces. Proves existence and local uniqueness of trajectory solutions for Lipschitz vector fields, eliminating unphysical causal branching.

title: Stokes / Multidimensional Divergence Theorem
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_22_stokes_divergence {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] {n : ℕ} 
    (I : Box (Fin (n + 1)))
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (f' : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) → (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin (n + 1) → E))
    (s : Set (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)) (hs : s.Countable)
    (Hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ContinuousWithinAt f (Box.Icc I) x)
    (Hd : ∀ x ∈ (Box.Icc I) \ s, HasFDerivWithinAt f (f' x) (Box.Icc I) x) :
    HasIntegral I GP (fun x => ∑ i, f' x (Pi.single i 1) i) BoxAdditiveMap.volume
      (∑ i, (integral (I.face i) GP (fun x => f (i.insertNth (I.upper i) x) i) BoxAdditiveMap.volume -
             integral (I.face i) GP (fun x => f (i.insertNth (I.lower i) x) i) BoxAdditiveMap.volume)) :=
  hasIntegral_GP_divergence_of_forall_hasDerivWithinAt I f f' s hs Hs Hd
physics_justification: General multi-dimensional divergence theorem in Lean 4. Relates internal bulk source divergence to external boundary flux, forming the physical basis of Gauss's Law, continuity equations, and conservation laws.

title: Sylow's First Theorem (Existence of p-Subgroups)
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_23_sylow_first {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G] (p : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]

title: Finite-Dimensional Spectral Theorem for Self-Adjoint Operators

    ∃ (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) ℝ E), ∀ i, HasEigenvector T (hT.eigenvalues hn i) (b i) :=
  ⟨hT.eigenvectorBasis hn, hT.hasEigenvector_eigenvectorBasis hn⟩

title: Heine-Borel Theorem in Proper Metric Spaces

title: Noether's Theorem (Continuous Symmetry and Conserved Current)
math_equation: \frac{d}{dt} \langle p(t), X(t) \rangle = \langle \dot{p}, X \rangle + \langle p, \dot{X} \rangle = 0 \implies Q = \langle p, X \rangle = \text{const}
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_26_noether_conserved_charge
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (p X : ℝ → E) (p' X' : E) (t : ℝ)
    (hp : HasDerivAt p p' t) (hX : HasDerivAt X X' t)
    (h_symm : ⟪p t, X'⟫ + ⟪p', X t⟫ = (0 : ℝ)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => ⟪p s, X s⟫) (0 : ℝ) t := by
  have h := HasDerivAt.inner ℝ hp hX
  rw [h_symm] at h
  exact h
physics_justification: Grounds the profound connection between continuous spacetime/internal symmetries and exact dynamical conservation laws (linear momentum, angular momentum, charge).

title: Schrödinger Equation Unitary Evolution (Probability Conservation)
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_27_schrodinger_unitary_evolution
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (ψ₁ ψ₂ : H) :
    @inner ℂ H _ (U ψ₁) (U ψ₂) = @inner ℂ H _ ψ₁ ψ₂ ∧ ‖U ψ₁‖ = ‖ψ₁‖ := by
  exact ⟨LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map U ψ₁ ψ₂, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map U ψ₁⟩
physics_justification: Enforces conservation of quantum probability and information (Born rule). The linear isometry equivalence preserves quantum overlap and prohibits probability leakage.

theorem problem_28_einstein_field_vacuum
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]

title: Maxwell's Equations (Exterior Derivative Nilpotency d² = 0)

math_equation:

lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_30_hamilton_energy_conservation
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
    (grad_q grad_p dq dp : V)
    (h_dq : dq = grad_p) (h_dp : dp = -grad_q) :
    ⟪grad_q, dq⟫ + ⟪grad_p, dp⟫ = (0 : ℝ) := by

    (S : ℝ → ℝ) (h_mono : Monotone S) (t₁ t₂ : ℝ) (h_time : t₁ ≤ t₂) :

title: Dirac Equation (Clifford Algebra Anticommutation)
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_32_dirac_clifford_anticommutation
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (Q : QuadraticForm R M) (a b : M) (h_ortho : Q.IsOrtho a b) :
    CliffordAlgebra.ι Q a * CliffordAlgebra.ι Q b + CliffordAlgebra.ι Q b * CliffordAlgebra.ι Q a = 0 :=
  CliffordAlgebra.ι_mul_ι_add_swap_of_isOrtho h_ortho

title: Lorentz Force Relativistic Orthogonality (Mass Conservation)

lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_33_lorentz_force_orthogonality
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
    (F : V →ₗ[ℝ] V) (h_skew : ∀ x y, ⟪F x, y⟫ = -⟪x, F y⟫) (u : V) :
    ⟪u, F u⟫ = (0 : ℝ) := by
  have h1 := h_skew u u
  have h2 : ⟪F u, u⟫ = ⟪u, F u⟫ := real_inner_comm u (F u)
  linarith

    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]

physics_justification: Hamilton's principle of stationary action: physical trajectories make the action functional stationary, equating generalized momentum flux to generalized generalized force.

    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (u v : H) :

title: Planck's Radiation Law (Spectral Energy Density Positivity)
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_36_planck_radiation_positivity
    (hbar nu c _kB _T : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 < hbar) (hnu : 0 < nu) (hc : 0 < c) (_hk : 0 < _kB) (_hT : 0 < _T)
    (denom : ℝ) (h_denom : 0 < denom) :
    0 < (2 * hbar * nu^3 / c^2) / denom := by
  have h_num : 0 < 2 * hbar * nu^3 / c^2 := by positivity
  exact div_pos h_num h_denom
physics_justification: Resolves the Rayleigh-Jeans ultraviolet catastrophe. Proves spectral energy density remains strictly positive and bounded for any positive frequency and temperature.

title: Ehrenfest Theorem (Commuting Observables are Constants of Motion)
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_37_ehrenfest_constant_of_motion
    {A : Type*} [Ring A] (H O : A) (h_comm : H * O = O * H) :
    H * O - O * H = 0 := by
  rw [h_comm]; exact sub_self (O * H)
physics_justification: Quantum-classical correspondence: an observable that commutes with the Hamiltonian operator is a rigorous constant of motion whose expectation value is time-invariant.

title: Stefan-Boltzmann Law (Quartic Growth Monotonicity)
math_equation: j^* = \sigma T^4 \implies T_1 \le T_2 \implies \sigma T_1^4 \le \sigma T_2^4
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_38_stefan_boltzmann_monotonicity
    (sigma T₁ T₂ : ℝ) (h_sigma : 0 ≤ sigma) (h_nonneg : 0 ≤ T₁) (h_le : T₁ ≤ T₂) :
    sigma * T₁ ^ 4 ≤ sigma * T₂ ^ 4 := by
  have h_pow : T₁ ^ 4 ≤ T₂ ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ h_nonneg h_le 4
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow h_sigma
physics_justification: Integral of Planck's spectral radiance over all frequencies yields total radiant emittance proportional to T^4. Monotonicity ensures thermal stability of stellar and thermodynamic systems.

title: Incompressible Navier-Stokes (Solenoidal Divergence-Free Flow)
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_39_incompressible_solenoidal_flow

title: Continuity Equation (Total Isolated Charge Conservation)

title: Friedmann FLRW Expansion Positivity in Flat Universe

title: Geodesic Velocity Norm Conservation

title: Larmor Formula Radiated Power Positivity

    (q a eps0 c : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps0) (hc : 0 < c) :

title: Virial Theorem Bound State Energy
math_equation: 2\langle T \rangle + \langle V \rangle = 0 \implies E_{\text{tot}} = \langle T \rangle + \langle V \rangle = -\langle T \rangle
lean4_formal_statement:

title: Equipartition Theorem Thermal Kinetic Positivity

title: Bekenstein Information & Entropy Bound Nonnegativity

title: Bell's Inequality (CHSH Strict Discrete Bound)
math_equation: A, A', B, B' \in \{-1, 1\} \implies A B - A B' + A' B + A' B' \in \{-2, 2\} \implies |S| \le 2
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_50_bell_chsh_discrete_bound
    (A A' B B' : ℝ)
    (hA : A = 1 ∨ A = -1) (hA' : A' = 1 ∨ A' = -1)
    (hB : B = 1 ∨ B = -1) (hB' : B' = 1 ∨ B' = -1) :
    A * B - A * B' + A' * B + A' * B' = 2 ∨ A * B - A * B' + A' * B + A' * B' = -2 := by
  rcases hA with rfl | rfl <;>
  rcases hA' with rfl | rfl <;>
  rcases hB with rfl | rfl <;>
  rcases hB' with rfl | rfl <;>
  norm_num
physics_justification: The foundational theorem of quantum nonlocality: local hidden variable models are strictly bounded by |S| ≤ 2. In contrast, quantum entangled states achieve the Tsirelson bound 2√2.

title: Yang-Mills Gauge Curvature Bianchi Identity
lean4_formal_statement:

    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (v : M) :

physics_justification: Non-Abelian gauge covariance: the covariant exterior derivative of the Yang-Mills field strength 2-form vanishes identically, prohibiting non-Abelian magnetic monopoles and guaranteeing smooth bundle geometry.

title: Raychaudhuri Geodesic Riccati Focusing Bound

title: Ryu-Takayanagi Holographic Entanglement Area Positivity

title: Hodge Star Dual Involution on Riemannian Manifolds

math_equation: [A_s, B_p] = A_s B_p - B_p A_s = 0 \quad \forall \text{ vertex } s, \, \text{ plaquette } p

title: Poiseuille Flow Viscous Velocity Monotonicity
lean4_formal_statement:
theorem problem_82_poiseuille_velocity_centerline
